components.text: These ores pulse faintly with residual mana. When mined, it yields small pieces of mana shards. Combining the different types of shards and a bit of mana one can create a larger and stronger mana crystal. The created gem itself explodes violently when hurled as a projectile but its true purpose lies in the summoning ritual.

Deeper still lies the much rarer Artifact Ore. These stones will yield forgotten relics of specific servant classes. These artifacts can be used during a summoning ritual to increasing the chance that a Servant of matching class will heed your call.
